response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced senior engineer with genuine low-latency and high-throughput systems exposure (Dunnhumby/Sociomantic) and strong open-source and mentoring credentials. However, he falls well short of the core requirement of 8 years of C++ experience (only ~7 months professionally at National Instruments plus a thesis project), and his career centers on web/full-stack development in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang rather than large-scale compute infrastructure. He also lacks demonstrated formal technical-leadership experience managing cross-team priorities and cloud/DevOps mentoring at the level this role demands.
strengths: Real high-scale, low-latency systems experience (micro-services handling millions of HTTP requests/second)
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, and open-source library authorship
Proven mentor and educator through workshops, courses, and community talks
concerns: Far below the 8-year C++ requirement; primary languages are TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang
No formal technical-lead role leading cloud/compute platform strategy or cross-team delivery
Career trajectory is web/product full-stack, not cloud compute platform or hardware-adjacent infrastructure

key_factors.factor: Lack of formal technical leadership experience
